name: Provision Shop Pulley Tin Display
description: Original static Singapore heritage exhibit: two empty enamel tins hang by seated bails from one continuous cord over an overhead grooved pulley.
summary: A pair of suspended unbranded open tins with real bail eyes, pulley and fixed timber section.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original turned enamel shell and sheave profiles, one continuous swept cord, attached tin bails and Cycles studio render.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Independent interpretive stand. Unbranded and empty, not a historical replica or commercial/storage instructions. Blender +Z up/-Y front; GLB +Y up/+Z front.

attribution.credit: All mesh, finish, original title and presentation are created for this exhibit.
National Heritage Board: historical local provision-shop use of pulley tins.
National Library Board BiblioAsia: first-hand account of a suspended tin pair in a local provision shop.
